text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After seizing victory in the Japanese<n>Derby,
Symboli Rudolf raises two<n>fingers high: two
crowns. The<n>Classic Triple Crown is starting to
look like a real possibility.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She resolves to claim the final crown<n>in the Kikuka
Sho, but her packed<n>schedule is starting to take its
toll, and<n>Air Groove is only getting more
concerned.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As usual, however, it's Symboli<n>Rudolf's way or
the highway. Even a<n>grueling race can't keep her
from her<n>student council duties.
